The p-value of the chi-squared test of independence between m6A methylation status and differential expression status is approximately 8.10e-194 (8.100776e-194).

This is the primary 3x3 Pearson chi-squared test (scipy.stats.chi2_contingency) on the contingency table of m6A status (m6A Hyper / m6A Hypo / m6A no sig) vs DEG status (Up / Down / no-DEGs), using all 12754 rows. chi2 = 901.45, dof = 4, p = 8.100776e-194. The result decisively rejects independence (m6A methylation status and differential expression status are strongly associated).

Sensitivity checks (conclusion robust): binary-reduction chi-square p = 8.32e-72; Fisher's exact test (binary 2x2) p = 8.22e-54.
